verdict.rationale: E2B's first-party docs say templates let developers define custom sandboxes: base image, environment variables, files to copy, commands to run and a start command. The CLI manages templates and can create sandboxes from a named template, and snapshots can be saved as named templates. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bringing an arbitrary pre-built container image from a registry or Dockerfile (only 'base image' selection is shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define custom sandbox templates or bring my own container image

citations.quote: E2B templates allow you to define custom sandboxes. You can define the base image, environment variables, files to copy, commands to run, and a start command
This gives you fully configured sandboxes with running processes ready to use with zero wait time for your users.
E2B CLI is a command line tool that allows you to manage and interact with sandboxes and templates.
You can name the snapshot template with the `--name` flag. If a template with that name already exists, it is reused.
